title: Snake Lemma: an interactive diagram chase
summary: Discover the Snake Lemma by chasing one element through a rigid commutative diagram with exact rows, using a small vocabulary of legal moves: apply a map, choose a lift (marked as a choice), use exactness, infer a kernel, rewrite around a commuting square, pass to a quotient. The guided proof constructs δ : ker γ → coker α and draws the snake only afterwards; a “try another lift” experiment with a Raw A / mod im α toggle shows the choices collapsing in coker α. Exactness chases at ker β, ker γ (correcting a lift), coker α and coker β; the ℤ example (α = 2, γ = 0, β(a, c) = (2a + c, 0), δ(n) = n mod 2) with a lift slider; a Chase Lab whose moves are generated from the mathematics; Break assumptions, a live proof trace, a ⌘K palette, presentation mode and stable state URLs. Exports a narrated beamdswitch deck (Short, Standard or Full, or the chase you just made) whose reveals are the page's own states. Deterministic, offline, from file:// and in an iframe, with a no-JavaScript document.
